contests.title: Bismarck Public School District No. 1 — School building bonds
contests.scopeNote: Exact named county or school-district electorate from the current official question and held Census registration.

provenance.quote: Shall Bismarck Public School District No. 1 of Burleigh County, North Dakota, issue its general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $116,500,000 maturing within a maximum of 20 years, resulting in an estimated additional millage of 9.45 mills, equal to $9.45 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation for the first taxable year after all of the bonds are issued, for the purpose of providing funds, together with any other funds available, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliance upgrades, to undertake facility improvements districtwide to address deferred maintenance and capital renewal needs including, but not limited to heating, ventilation, plumbing and electrical system upgrades, building envelope repairs and related infrastructure improvements, including entrances, elevators, restrooms, site circulation and other modifications necessary to improve equitable access to District facilities, together with related site work, equipment, furnishings, and incidental costs.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Foster County to assess up to four mills in property taxes for county agent extension services for a period of no more than ten years, under the two state-law sections named in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve authority to assess up to four mills for extension services for up to ten years.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed four-mill extension-services levy authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Hettinger County to assess up to four mills for county agent extension services for no more than ten years. This would restore authority for two mills above the current two-mill limit. The county’s official explanation says the additional authority would continue until 2036; its previous four-mill authority expired at the end of 2024.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve authority to assess up to four mills for extension services for up to ten years.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed increase in extension-services levy authority.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Bismarck Public School District No. 1 to borrow up to $116.5 million through general-obligation bonds, repayable within 20 years. Projects would improve disability access and address deferred maintenance and capital-renewal needs across the district, including heating, ventilation, plumbing, electrical systems, building exteriors, entrances, elevators, restrooms, site circulation, equipment and furnishings. The ballot estimates an additional 9.45 mills, or $9.45 per $1,000 of taxable value, in the first taxable year after all bonds are issued.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $116.5 million in bonds for those facility projects, with a maximum 20-year repayment period.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed school-facility borrowing authority.
